tests.name: PASS: test-step-baton-config (AC1-AC4, NS4)

acceptanceCriteria.text: The project hub config accepts `defaults.stepRunners` (step number to runner id) and `defaults.runners` (runner id to `{command, timeoutSeconds, env}`); the command template supports `{prompt}`, `{cwd}`, `{slug}`, and `{step}` substitutions with the same vocabulary as the Tier 2 CLI template.

tests.name: PASS: test-step-baton-config (AC1-AC4, NS4)

acceptanceCriteria.text: Runner ids are opaque neutral strings validated against `defaults.runners`; an unknown step key, an unknown runner id, or an empty command fails fast with a named error before Step 0 dispatch and never starts a partial run.

tests.name: PASS: test-step-baton-config (AC1-AC4, NS4)

acceptanceCriteria.text: Steps without a runner mapping fall back to the current single-host dispatch (Tier 1/2/3 plus `stepModels`); a run config may map any subset of steps, including a single step.

tests.name: PASS: test-step-baton-config (AC1-AC4, NS4)

acceptanceCriteria.text: Runner map keys are validated against the owning `workflowType` step set (0–9 standard, 0–5 lite); a key outside the set fails fast with a named error.

tests.name: PASS: test-step-baton-claim (AC5, AC6, AC8; NS1, NS7)

acceptanceCriteria.text: The workflow state carries a `baton` record `{holder, step, claimedAt, leaseUntil, revision}`; a claim succeeds only when the presented revision equals the stored revision and no live lease exists, and the write goes through the existing atomic dual-write path.

tests.name: PASS: test-step-baton-claim (AC5, AC6, AC8; NS1, NS7)

acceptanceCriteria.text: Step completion releases the baton exactly once: `finish` writes the step handoff, clears the holder, and advances `currentStep` in the same atomic update; the next runner may claim only the baton for the new `currentStep`.

tests.name: PASS: test-step-coordinator (AC7, AC9-AC14; NS2, NS3, NS5, NS6)

acceptanceCriteria.text: A lease past `leaseUntil` with no `finish` becomes re-claimable by the coordinator, which logs the expiry with old holder, step, and attempt count; after `maxAttempts` (default 2) consecutive expiries on one step the workflow moves to `blocked` and the coordinator stops.

tests.name: PASS: test-step-baton-claim (AC5, AC6, AC8; NS1, NS7)

acceptanceCriteria.text: Concurrent claim attempts serialize on the revision check; the loser receives a named conflict error and retries with backoff, and no step body ever executes twice for the same attempt.

tests.name: PASS: test-step-coordinator (AC7, AC9-AC14; NS2, NS3, NS5, NS6)

acceptanceCriteria.text: A deterministic coordinator script (plain Node, no LLM session) owns the run loop for one `workflowId`: read config and state, claim the baton, spawn the mapped worker, await exit, verify advancement, repeat until terminal status.

tests.name: PASS: test-step-coordinator (AC7, AC9-AC14; NS2, NS3, NS5, NS6)

acceptanceCriteria.text: The coordinator is the only polling party: it re-reads state on a configured interval (default 30s, allowed range 5–300s) to detect external advancement; worker CLIs are spawned one-shot per turn and never left idling or polling.

tests.name: PASS: test-step-coordinator (AC7, AC9-AC14; NS2, NS3, NS5, NS6)

acceptanceCriteria.text: All Transition Gates and `user-gate` prompts surface at the coordinator as pause-and-prompt, or auto-apply index 0 in `autoMode`; a worker process must not emit a gate, and a gate-shaped worker output is recorded as a worker protocol violation without advancing the step.

tests.name: PASS: test-step-coordinator (AC7, AC9-AC14; NS2, NS3, NS5, NS6)

acceptanceCriteria.text: The coordinator verifies post-exit that `currentStep` advanced and the expected step artifacts exist on disk; a clean exit without advancement is treated as a failed attempt under the AC7 retry policy, never as success.

tests.name: PASS: test-step-coordinator (AC7, AC9-AC14; NS2, NS3, NS5, NS6)

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each worker spawn receives the Tier 2 sparse-pointer payload (spec path, plan index, AC ledger, prior handoff) plus its baton envelope `{step, holder, leaseUntil, attempt}`; the worker must call `finish` for its step before exit.

tests.name: PASS: test-step-coordinator (AC7, AC9-AC14; NS2, NS3, NS5, NS6)

acceptanceCriteria.text: A non-zero worker exit, a timeout past `timeoutSeconds`, or a missing `finish` leaves the step unadvanced; the coordinator records failure telemetry and applies the AC7 retry policy instead of advancing.

tests.name: PASS: test-step-baton-telemetry (AC15)

acceptanceCriteria.text: Every claim, release, expiry, spawn, and exit appends to the run `telemetry.jsonl` as `baton_claimed`, `baton_released`, `baton_lease_expired`, `runner_spawned`, or `runner_exited` with step, holder, attempt, and exit code fields.

tests.name: PASS: test-step-baton-monitor (AC16)

acceptanceCriteria.text: State readers derive the current holder, lease, and mapped runner per step from the state file alone with no side-channel files; `ws-monitor` snapshots include the baton holder and lease without changing their read-only contract.

tests.name: PASS: test-step-baton-specmemo (AC17)

acceptanceCriteria.text: When spec-memo integration is enabled, the coordinator mirrors each released step handoff summary into the vault handoff payload shape (`nextSteps` from the next-step pointers); when integration is disabled the run behaves identically with zero vault calls.

tests.name: PASS: test-step-baton-claim (AC5, AC6, AC8; NS1, NS7)

negativeScenarios.text: Two coordinators claim the same step at the same revision: exactly one claim wins and the loser receives the named conflict error.

tests.name: PASS: test-step-coordinator (AC7, AC9-AC14; NS2, NS3, NS5, NS6)

negativeScenarios.text: Worker exits 0 without calling `finish`: the coordinator treats the turn as a failed attempt and does not advance `currentStep`.

tests.name: PASS: test-step-coordinator (AC7, AC9-AC14; NS2, NS3, NS5, NS6)

negativeScenarios.text: Worker exceeds `timeoutSeconds`: the coordinator kills the spawn, records `runner_exited` with timeout cause, and applies the retry policy.

tests.name: PASS: test-step-baton-config (AC1-AC4, NS4)

negativeScenarios.text: Run config maps a step to an undeclared runner id: the run refuses to start with a named error before any dispatch.

negativeScenarios.text: Worker emits gate-shaped output: the coordinator records a protocol violation and the step stays unadvanced.

tests.name: PASS: test-step-coordinator (AC7, AC9-AC14; NS2, NS3, NS5, NS6)

negativeScenarios.text: State file edited out-of-band mid-run (revision jump): the coordinator stops with a named changed-underfoot error instead of overwriting the edit.
